subject: Re: Kickoff: MULLER learned resizer — staffing + budget
body:
Hi Anders,

Staffing: Yara Jokic 30% leads the integration and the offline A/B (she's also carrying the muNet close this spring, hence the modest slice); Oyin Iversen 30% on the preprocessing plumbing and serving parity checks; Hyun Traore 20% consulting on the training-side interactions, since a learned resizer changes what the towers see during fine-tuning.

Funding is settled: Idris verbally earmarked $120k from the Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-77 for this project, which covers the retraining sweeps for the retrieval towers with MULLER in the input path. The April single-tower work fits in our existing best-effort allocation (24 titan-a100 GPUs); the May sweep is what the earmark actually pays for.

One caution so we don't oversell: MULLER's wins in the paper come when the downstream model is trained (or at least fine-tuned) with the resizer in the loop. A pure drop-in with frozen towers may show nothing — that's precisely what Yara's April A/B will settle before we spend the sweep money.

Deshawn
